correctness.rationale: The F/PI/NI axioms force equal issue-downsets along accessibility and thus an equivalence partition with full-support component downsets. Inclusion-exclusion c_m=sum(-1)^j binom(m,j)M(m-j) and the exponential formula enumerate exactly. Independently reproduced c_1..c_6=(1,2,9,114,6894,7785062), F_1..F_6=(1,3,16,175,7815,7833957). The symbolic asymptotic is not extrapolated from these numbers: b_m=binom(m,floor m/2) yields c_m~M(m), b_(m-1)/b_m→1/2, b_(n-2)+2 bounds all other nonuniversal partition types. Kleitman–Markowsky upper bound and the lower bound from arbitrary middle-layer antichains make the total other-defect mass o(n c_(n-1)). Definitions n>=1, labelled, single agent, no valuations; F_0=1 is formal only.
